name: Kansas

response.rule_text: A request must be acted on as soon as possible but not later than the third business day after receipt, K.S.A. 45-218(d); if access is not immediate the custodian must give a detailed explanation (45-218(c)).

fees.labor_rule: Copy fees may not exceed actual cost of furnishing copies, including staff time; state-agency memo gives free service for under one hour of staff time or fewer than 25 pages.
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of furnishing copies; $0.25 per page deemed reasonable; AG reports 20 cents per page also reasonable.

appeal.body: District court; Attorney General may investigate and issue findings/consent orders
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal on the merits; requester may go directly to district court. The AG (or county/district attorney) may investigate and, after 2023-era enforcement changes described by RCFP, find a violation and enter a consent order before suit. Fee disputes with state agencies may be appealed to the Secretary of Administration, whose decision is final.

notes: Governor and other executive offices are 'public agencies' under KORA. Legislature: records kept by individual legislators are not public records (partial); universities: a university athletic association was held not a public agency (partial). Silence-is-denial and appeal deadline not found. K.S.A. 45-219 fee citation inferred from fee topic, not seen. fees.search_allowed null: staff time appears only in the copy-cost rule, not as an explicit search fee.
